description: Birthday cakes! Play the sound game to hear a harp's sound! What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game? A shoe.

title: Hippa Hippa Hey
description: At a picnic! Help Hippa find the missing part to complete the light bulb. Join Sophie to find out which color matches the sun. Yellow, of course.

title: Choopies
description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with.

title: Choopies
description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with.

title: Songs & Rhymes
description: All your favorite BabyTV characters are rolling over in the bed. Be careful not to fall out.

title: Little Lola Visits the City
description: The giraffes play soccer in the park when their ball gets stuck in the tree. How will they get it down.

title: Little Lola Visits the City
description: Little boy doesn't know in which recylcing bin to throw his glass lightbulb. The animals have a great time playing their instruments in music class.

title: Little Lola Visits the City
description: Peter and little bear play soccer in the park when their ball gets stuck in the tree. How will they get it down.

title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal makes a moo sound! Can you guess which vegetable is brown and strange.

title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal makes a quack sound! Can you guess which vegetable is round.

title: Ahoy Lollipops
description: The Lollipops go on an adventure to find the treasure. On the way they play games and solve puzzles.

title: Snail Trail
description: Mr. Snail meets a beaver and his son by the lake! Come watch them cut down a tree with their teeth.

title: Snail Trail
description: Mr. Snail meets a magical chameleon! At first he's green and then he's brown.

title: Songs & Rhymes
description: What's more fun than eating cakes and breads? Eating them with your favorite BabyTV characters - Hungry Henry, Billy and Bambam, Draco and Oliver.

title: Songs & Rhymes
description: Billy and Bam have fun watching the bears make food together. Sometimes things don't go quite as expected but that's part of the fun.

title: Travelers
description: Harley and Perry go apple picking. They find a huge apple they really want to pick but they discover there's a cute worm living inside the apple.

title: Pix & Leo
description: Monkey is gathering delicious fruit in his leaf and he doesn't want to share any with Pix and Leo. But, oh no! There is a hole in Monkey's leaf.

title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
description: Mowgli, Leela and Gray accidently kick their ball into a spooky cave. Mowgli gets quite a fright when trying to get the ball back.

title: Zeina's Detective Agency
description: A broom arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused broom discover its true use.

title: Zeina's Detective Agency
description: A kite arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused kite discover its true use.

title: Mike's Bikes
description: Johnny wants a bell for his bike so everyone can hear that he's coming. Will Mikey be able to help.

title: Mike's Bikes
description: Petite wants to open a lemonade stand, but the lemons keep falling off her bike. Mikey offer to help with trays and even an entire kitchen.

title: Mike's Bikes
description: Bunny wants to ride her bike with a cape, but her cape keeps getting stuck in the bike chain. Will Mikey be able to help.

title: Mona & Sketch
description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become hairdressers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles shampoo! A red-head puppy needs a haircut.

title: Mona & Sketch
description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become mountaineers! Climb the high mountain, paint fluffy clouds and tickle the sky way up high.

title: Mice Builders
description: Mice Builders are enthusiastically devoted to building their new house. When a messenger arrives with a package, they put down their tools and attempt to guess what's inside.

title: Billy Bam Bam
description: Join them as they use building blocks and sticks to create a wonderful game of limbo! So how low can you go.

title: Billy Bam Bam
description: Join them as they use a chalkstone to draw arrows and signs and play follow me.

title: The Tiny Bunch
description: Giraffe, Squirrel, and Baby want to play with a ball. Will they be able to take the ball from Elephant's house without waking her up.

title: The Tiny Bunch
description: Rabbit is great at doing magic tricks. Will Baby butterfly be able to be a true magician? Join them as they have fun pulling surprises out of hats.

title: The Tiny Bunch
description: Baby and Hippo have planned a day at the beach together. But once they get there, Hippo disappears. Come join Baby as he looks for Hippo.

title: Bath Tubbies
description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are playing ball in the bath! The water is flowing down through a hole! Come and find the plug on the turtle's head.

title: Bath Tubbies
description: The friends want to play ball but the tub is full of toys! Join them as they put the toys in a bucket.

title: Bath Tubbies
description: Join the friends as they float inside the bubbles and slide down a colourful rainbow made of bubbles.

title: Look What I Found
description: The friends have fun wearing a black hat! Join them as they put on a magic show before a cheering crowd of sheep.

title: Look What I Found
description: The friends play with a pot and a spoon! The pot flips over and turns into a drum.

title: Look What I Found
description: The friends have fun sweeping with a broom! Come along as the broom turns into a happy horse.

title: The Cuddlies
description: Everyone is getting ready for bedtime. Uh Oh fills his bed with items, but it breaks due to overload.

title: The Cuddlies
description: Yum Yum loves spending lots of time alone at his new tomato patch, so his friends go away.

title: The Cuddlies
description: Tickles wants to form a band and composes a tune to play. The friends joke around, so Tickles gets upset.
